I am an old woman here in Zomba, and this small plot near the house I keep for beans and pigeon pea mixed together. Beans do not need much fertilizer like maize does, so I will save my FISP coupon fertilizer for my maize plot — on these legumes I just put a little manure from the goats and chickens. I use the seed I saved from last harvest, the same local beans my mother grew, because improved bean seed is hard to find and costs money I do not have. I weed myself with my daughter-in-law, and if the work is too much at planting I ask a neighbour for one or two days and pay with a bit of the harvest.
